tables.name: stories
tables.label: Stories
tables.description: The merged, ranked story list for your outlet languages, timeframe and filters (computed on the device from our news server's files). Replaced on every refresh; local scratch, never synced.

tables.name: articles
tables.label: Articles
tables.description: The covering articles of the story you opened: each outlet's own headline, its own category label verbatim, publish time and the original link.

tables.name: sources
tables.label: Sources
tables.description: Every outlet of your outlet languages with its article count in the current timeframe and whether it is in your feed.

tables.name: countries
tables.label: Countries
tables.description: Countries the current stories mention (mechanical gazetteer match on the server, no AI), most covered first.

tables.name: mapshade
tables.label: Map shading
tables.description: Per-country 3-step shade for the news map, plus two scale anchors.

tables.name: mapsel
tables.label: Map selection
tables.description: Filter target for the country tapped on the news map (holds no rows).

tables.name: info
tables.label: Feed info
tables.description: One row: when the server built the files and the current counts.

tables.name: languages
tables.label: Languages
tables.description: The outlet languages the server serves, with outlet counts and archive span.

tables.name: prefs
tables.label: Preferences
tables.description: Your outlet languages, timeframe, sort, outlet-origin filters and switched-off outlets. Stays on this device.

tables.name: mysources
tables.label: Your sources
tables.description: Feeds you added from the directory or by URL. Stored on this device only; the app does not fetch other sites yet.
